description: This file defines the class FineractJwtAuthenticationToken, which extends JwtAuthenticationToken to include additional user details for security context in a Fineract project.

classes.name: FineractJwtAuthenticationToken
classes.description: A custom authentication token that extends JwtAuthenticationToken to include UserDetails information.

methods.name: FineractJwtAuthenticationToken
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the token with JWT, authorities, and user details.

methods.name: getPrincipal
methods.description: Returns the UserDetails object associated with this authentication token.
